svg.title: Latest Scriptw versus V8: elapsed time and process memory

cc:Work.dc:title: Latest Scriptw versus V8: elapsed time and process memory
cc:Work.dc:description: Latest verified Scriptw versus V8, all 17 fresh Store/Realm workloads. Measured 2026-10-25 01:50 UTC; compiler ab97459e54f9e0cd3ed983d098c46ccacac8fec6. Lower is better. Paired bars use a shared zero-based linear scale within each section: median elapsed milliseconds and median post-execution process RSS in MiB. RSS includes host/runtime, setup and retained warmup effects; it is not live JavaScript heap usage or a peak. Each runtime has 14 measured observations from two rounds of seven after ten warmups. Existing-Realm calls are separate. Source report SHA-256: 37c6d7eca2c7a22377bd1da90755d65b631786a4768e3c1a9a0408462083ab12. Archive SHA-256: 7efa80aa5fc5bff6063224ae8b13000d0da0fd1dcb8c023d24191340726e11c5. sort-reverse-128.js: V8 0.019 ms, Scriptw 2.751 ms; V8 RSS 52.7 MiB, Scriptw RSS 335.7 MiB. sort-reverse-512.js: V8 0.098 ms, Scriptw 9.861 ms; V8 RSS 53.7 MiB, Scriptw RSS 343.5 MiB. sort-sorted-512.js: V8 0.110 ms, Scriptw 7.762 ms; V8 RSS 53.7 MiB, Scriptw RSS 344.1 MiB. to-sorted-512.js: V8 0.103 ms, Scriptw 8.120 ms; V8 RSS 53.7 MiB, Scriptw RSS 343.8 MiB. join-1024.js: V8 0.052 ms, Scriptw 8.995 ms; V8 RSS 53.9 MiB, Scriptw RSS 346.0 MiB. join-4096.js: V8 0.661 ms, Scriptw 33.907 ms; V8 RSS 61.5 MiB, Scriptw RSS 344.2 MiB. join-mixed-1024.js: V8 0.203 ms, Scriptw 9.676 ms; V8 RSS 57.2 MiB, Scriptw RSS 344.4 MiB. numeric-loop-10000.js: V8 0.526 ms, Scriptw 1.624 ms; V8 RSS 59.2 MiB, Scriptw RSS 329.8 MiB. numeric-loop-50000.js: V8 0.877 ms, Scriptw 4.873 ms; V8 RSS 61.2 MiB, Scriptw RSS 329.9 MiB. folded-string-4096.js: V8 0.155 ms, Scriptw 2.171 ms; V8 RSS 59.2 MiB, Scriptw RSS 331.6 MiB. dynamic-string-4096.js: V8 0.191 ms, Scriptw 3.461 ms; V8 RSS 61.0 MiB, Scriptw RSS 330.0 MiB. integer.js: V8 2.094 ms, Scriptw 5.068 ms; V8 RSS 60.0 MiB, Scriptw RSS 330.3 MiB. objects.js: V8 0.056 ms, Scriptw 5.608 ms; V8 RSS 53.8 MiB, Scriptw RSS 340.8 MiB. retained-objects.js: V8 2.941 ms, Scriptw 431.177 ms; V8 RSS 71.6 MiB, Scriptw RSS 356.3 MiB. join-empty-1024.js: V8 0.165 ms, Scriptw 2.930 ms; V8 RSS 58.4 MiB, Scriptw RSS 333.5 MiB. join-singleton-1024.js: V8 0.184 ms, Scriptw 3.131 ms; V8 RSS 56.4 MiB, Scriptw RSS 333.8 MiB. join-small-1024.js: V8 0.226 ms, Scriptw 3.994 ms; V8 RSS 57.3 MiB, Scriptw RSS 334.1 MiB.
